description: Waste fees of Swiss communes from official open data, where the canton publishes every commune: canton of Zurich (all communes, since 2000: yearly basic fee converted to a 4-room flat and price per 35-litre bag) and Basel-Landschaft (bag price, basic fee per household, dog tax). CHF incl. VAT. With commune (name or BFS number): that commune incl. its history; without: every covered commune's latest values. Other cantons publish no per-commune table.

commune.description: commune name or BFS number, optional
